scan_all.title: Scan All Devices
scan_all.description: Scan database record IDs starting at ID 0. If WX name lookup is configured, programmed names are retrieved automatically.

edit_confirm.title: Rename Device
edit_confirm.description: Enter the new name for device ID {id}.

configure_connection.title: Automation Service Connection
configure_connection.description: Edit the TCP Automation and Control connection. Leave Service PIN blank to keep the existing PIN.

data.password: New Service PIN (leave blank to keep current)

configure_wx_names.title: Protege WX Name Lookup
configure_wx_names.description: Optional. Enter the Protege WX web operator credentials used only for read-only programmed-name lookup during scans. Leave the password blank to keep the saved password. Clear the username to disable WX name lookup.

scan_doors.title: Scan Doors
scan_doors.description: Scans from database ID 0 up to the selected maximum. With WX name lookup configured, actual programmed door names are used.

scan_areas.title: Scan Areas
scan_areas.description: Scans from database ID 0 up to the selected maximum. With WX name lookup configured, actual programmed area names are used.

scan_inputs.title: Scan Inputs
scan_inputs.description: Scans from database ID 0 up to the selected maximum. With WX name lookup configured, actual programmed input names are used.

scan_outputs.title: Scan Outputs
scan_outputs.description: Scans from database ID 0 up to the selected maximum. With WX name lookup configured, actual programmed output names are used.
